</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["ERR-DSGN-009: Assuming floor-to-floor = 2.7 m or 3.5 m instead of the NBC standard 3.0 m. Always verify against the project standard before accepting a section.","Using dashed lines to show visible edges beyond a section cut (should use solid outlines for clarity).","Misaligning fenestration on elevation with the structural grid shown on the floor plan—always cross-reference the two.","Forgetting to label section cut locations on floor plans with clear arrows and matching labels on the section elevation.","Mixing elevation directions (labeling an east-facing elevation as 'Front' without confirming site orientation first).","Failing to show grade line and reference elevation data—sections are meaningless without vertical datum.","Crowding dimension annotations, making it unclear which height corresponds to which floor-to-floor distance."]} />
